question: Jivita is the daughter of Kalyan, Kalyan has two sons. Anjali is the daughter of Manojna. Manojna is the wife of Kalyan's son. Veena is Pavan's mother. Pavan is the brother of Raju. Raju is the father of Anjali. How is Anjali related to Veena?
solution:
Family Chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1fe9ab3dacc543807a2678698ddb41719e81d30f4eac76f273a4d30876cf59b.png] 

Family tree according to the given information :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6210e5c05d530c2929f07fbc145d84de39d88e9b0e1ce77e90e6f524fb5eab49.png] 

From family tree,

Veena is the wife of Kalyan, Kalyan is the father of Jivita, Jivita is the sister of Pavan and Raju, Raju is the husband of Manojna and Manojna is the mother of Anjali.

So, **Anjali is the granddaughter of Veena.**

Hence, **"Granddaughter" **is the correct answer.
